delivery.experience_text:
Use the matched guidance together where supported by the current task and source. If advice conflicts, resolve it against the concrete requirements and explain the choice; do not combine incompatible obligations.

Matched experience 8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc
8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R01 [Applicability]
The current contract retains history for admitted progress, while UI updates belong to the originating visit. Decoding may complete immediately or later.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R02 [Event relation]
Bind decoding to the visit and attempt that admitted it. On completion, retain the required number of history effects, then recheck visit validity before painting. History callbacks may also navigate, requiring another validity check.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R03 [Preservation]
Retain admitted audit effects and valid progress for the new visit. Listener removal alone does not cancel decoding already started.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not use one early validity check to control both auditing and display. Follow another task's explicit discard policy if it revokes the history obligation.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R05 [Verification]
Complete decoding across hide, switch, retry and same-source reopening. Check history cardinality, no retired-panel painting and display permission after navigation in a history callback.


Matched experience 092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce
092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R01 [Applicability]
Saving or subscription cleanup synchronously calls host listeners that may open another document or close the workspace.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R02 [Event relation]
Capture the old view and remove its current ownership. Finish final old-view effects, such as clearing its display, before callback-capable saving, or check authority for effects remaining after callbacks. An outer open rechecks its request identity after retirement.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R03 [Preservation]
Nested open/close, nested editing and the new view's rendering remain authoritative. Disposal also cleans up captured resources rather than clearing objects installed by a callback.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R04 [Exclusion]
Protecting only final view installation can still leave a later stale clearing render. Do not require every host to detach first; notification order follows the current contract.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R05 [Verification]
Invoke open/close inside listeners for timer-driven and departure-driven saves. Check document output, subscriptions and nested edits after the outer call returns, through both direct calls and actual unmounting.


Matched experience 400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df
400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R01 [Applicability]
The current contract retains an admitted history or audit effect after navigation while UI feedback belongs to the originating visit.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R02 [Event relation]
Keep admission, retained settlement and visible publication separate. Preserve each admitted audit effect according to its cardinality contract, then recheck the originating visit immediately before painting.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R03 [Preservation]
A newer display or removal of a listener does not erase independently retained audit obligations. Recheck UI permission after callback-capable auditing.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not impose audit retention on a task that explicitly discards that work, or allow retained audit to authorize stale UI effects.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R05 [Verification]
Complete admitted decoding after hide, switch and same-source reopening; check retained audit, no retired-owner painting and continuing current-owner delivery.


Matched experience 380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602
380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R01 [Applicability]
One startup may emit multiple packets synchronously. Handling the first may hide the panel or open another visit before startup returns physical cleanup capability.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R02 [Event relation]
Check the originating visit and attempt before each packet enters decoding. Retirement immediately revokes later admission without waiting for physical listener removal.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R03 [Preservation]
Previously admitted packets settle under their separate audit and display contracts. The new visit receives bootstrap and later updates normally.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R04 [Exclusion]
Zero listeners after cleanup does not establish correctness during startup. Do not confuse previously admitted work with packets arriving after retirement.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R05 [Verification]
Hide, switch and reopen the same source from the first synchronous callback. Emit more packets before outer startup returns, and independently check rejection of new packets and settlement of admitted packets.


Matched experience 020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892
020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R01 [Applicability]
Startup, cleanup, saving or publication can synchronously reenter navigation and install a new owner.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R02 [Event relation]
Capture old resources and publish retirement before callback-capable work. Establish provisional cleanup ownership before startup where needed. After callbacks, recheck request and owner identity before installing a returned handle or publishing a destination.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R03 [Preservation]
Complete cleanup for captured old resources without clearing or taking ownership of a newer visit. Preserve the documented idempotent cleanup behavior.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not assume code after a synchronous callback still owns the current view. Do not hard-code one cleanup ordering when the current API requires a different order; guard remaining effects.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R05 [Verification]
Exercise hide, switch and dispose inside startup, detachment and saving; check both resulting view and resource ownership after the outer call returns.

change_summary: Extend editor navigation guidance with reusable trailing batches and synchronous persistence boundaries.
Add snapshot and confirmation acquisition before callback-capable submission flushing.
Narrow callback claims to source-established listener delivery and retain documented disposal ordering as an adapter limitation.
update.reason: Revise the editor-navigation experience because its retirement and navigation guards directly apply, but its rules do not fully specify the batching and submission checkpoints supported by TASK, README.md and src/workflow.rb. The progress-decoding and startup experiences concern mechanisms not established here, so they are not merged. Attempt 1 illustrates the added checkpoints and has a reported passing verdict; no implementation failure or contradictory guidance is established.
